title: TaxClearanceCertificateExtractionSchema
description: Schema for extracting the variable content required to reproduce the Nepali Tax Clearance Certificate as an English A4 document. Fixed English labels are supplied by the template. Preserve names, numbers, dates, and amounts; translate official Nepali administrative/legal text into English where requested.

emblem_present.description: True when the Nepal Coat of Arms is visibly present in the upper-left header.

office_government.description: Government heading translated to English. For this document: 'Government of Nepal'.

office_ministry.description: Ministry heading translated to English. For this document: 'Ministry of Finance'.

office_department.description: Department heading translated to English. For this document: 'Inland Revenue Department'.

office_main.description: Main office name translated to English. For this document: 'Inland Revenue Office Lahan'.

office_suboffice.description: Sub-office/controller heading translated to English. Preserve the place name. For this document: 'Treasury and Accounts Controller Office, Udayapur'.

rule_reference.description: The separate statutory reference line beneath the office heading, translated to English. For this document: 'Related to Rule 26 of Income Tax Rules, 2079'.

letter_no.description: Letter number exactly as printed. Preserve all digits and separators.

registration_no.description: Registration/reference number exactly as printed. Preserve all digits and separators.

tax_clearance_no.description: Tax Clearance Number exactly as printed. Preserve all digits and separators.

issue_date_nepali.description: Original issue/preparation date in Bikram Sambat exactly as printed.

issue_date_gregorian.description: Issue/preparation date converted to Gregorian for the English output, preferably YYYY-MM-DD.

issue_date_sentence.description: Complete issue/preparation sentence translated to English, not just a date. Example: 'This letter has been prepared on 2082.10.23 BS.' Preserve the date exactly and retain the full sentence structure.

print_date_nepali.description: Print date in Bikram Sambat exactly as printed.

print_date_gregorian.description: Print date converted to Gregorian for the English output, preferably YYYY-MM-DD.

print_date_sentence.description: Complete print-date line translated to English. Example: 'Print Date: 2082.10.23 BS.'

qr_present.description: True when a QR code is visibly present in the upper-right header area.

seal_present.description: True when an official round seal/stamp is visibly present on the document.

subject.description: Subject translated into English. For this certificate: 'Tax Clearance Certificate'.

recipient_salutation.description: The salutation exactly as written in the letter before the recipient name. Preserve repeated honorifics. For example, if the source says 'श्री श्री श्री', transliterate it as 'Shri Shri Shri'. Do not remove duplicates or normalize it.

recipient_name.description: Recipient's name exactly as printed after the salutation. Preserve the person's or institution's wording and transliterate Nepali text to English characters where necessary.

recipient_address.description: Recipient address as printed, preserving all visible address lines. Translate administrative labels into English but do not invent or semantically alter place names.

recipient_pan.description: Recipient PAN exactly as printed. Preserve all digits.

main_text.description: Complete main certificate paragraph translated into English. Preserve the tax year, statement date, and meaning of the certificate text.

statement_date_nepali.description: Income statement submission date in BS exactly as printed.

statement_date_gregorian.description: Income statement submission date converted to Gregorian for English output.

income_items.description: Financial table rows. Preserve amounts exactly; do not calculate or reformat values.

submission_date.description: Income statement date for the row. Use the source date or reliable Gregorian conversion according to the English output.

total_income.description: Total income/turnover exactly as printed, including commas and decimal points.

signature_label.description: Signature/official designation text associated with the certification area, translated to English if it is Nepali.

certifying_officer_name.description: Certifying officer's name, if visible. Preserve/transliterate the name; do not translate a personal name.

certifying_officer_title.description: Certifying officer's official designation translated into English.

remarks.description: All footer legal/instructional notes translated into English. Preserve all substantive notes and numbering.
